page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-384-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It is equipped with 384 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system features a substantial memory capacity of 3024.0 GB, which yields approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per virtual core. While the configuration specifies NVMe SSD as the local storage type, the local storage size is designated as None. There are no GPUs integrated into this instance, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Designed for high-density enterprise workloads, this server offers a high ratio of memory to dedicated vCPUs, positioning it as a highly resource-dense option. Qualitatively, the massive allocation of 384 dedicated vCPUs and over three terabytes of system memory represents a premium hardware class optimized for massive parallel processing and large in-memory datasets. A key tradeoff is the lack of hardware-accelerated graphics or GPU coprocessors, making it unsuitable for deep learning training or GPU-bound rendering tasks. The instance is best suited for large-scale databases, memory-intensive enterprise applications, big data analytics, and high-throughput transactional workloads.
